import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from transformers import get_linear_schedule_with_warmup
import os
import re
import joblib
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train_text = train_df["text"].values
y_author = train_df["author"].values
X_test_text = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y_author)
num_classes = len(label_encoder.classes_)

# ============================================================
# 2. STRATIFIED SPLIT (70% train, 15% val, 15% test from train)
# ============================================================
X_tr_text, X_va_text, y_tr, y_va = train_test_split(
    X_train_text, y_encoded, test_size=0.3, stratify=y_encoded, random_state=42
)
X_va_text, X_te_text, y_va, y_te = train_test_split(
    X_va_text, y_va, test_size=0.5, stratify=y_va, random_state=42
)

print(f"Train: {len(X_tr_text)}, Val: {len(X_va_text)}, Test: {len(X_te_text)}")


# ============================================================
# 3. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Syntactic/Stylometric Features
# ============================================================
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        feat = [
            len(text_str),
            len(words),
            len(sentences),
            np.mean([len(s) for s in sentences]) if sentences else 0,
            np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0,
            text_str.count(",") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(".") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("!") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("?") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(";") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(":") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count('"') / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("'") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            sum(c.isupper() for c in text_str) / max(1, len(text_str)),
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)


print("Extracting stylometric features...")
stylo_tr = extract_stylometric_features(X_tr_text)
stylo_va = extract_stylometric_features(X_va_text)
stylo_te = extract_stylometric_features(X_te_text)
stylo_test = extract_stylometric_features(X_test_text)

scaler_stylo = StandardScaler()
stylo_tr = scaler_stylo.fit_transform(stylo_tr)
stylo_va = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_va)
stylo_te = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_te)
stylo_test = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_test)

# ============================================================
# 4. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Character n-gram TF-IDF
# ============================================================
print("Extracting character n-gram features...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
)
char_tr = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr_text)
char_va = char_vectorizer.transform(X_va_text)
char_te = char_vectorizer.transform(X_te_text)
char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# ============================================================
# 5. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Word-level TF-IDF
# ============================================================
print("Extracting word-level features...")
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    stop_words=None,
)
word_tr = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr_text)
word_va = word_vectorizer.transform(X_va_text)
word_te = word_vectorizer.transform(X_te_text)
word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# ============================================================
# 6. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Sentence-BERT Embeddings
# ============================================================
print("Extracting Sentence-BERT embeddings...")
sbert_name = "all-mpnet-base-v2"
sbert_model = SentenceTransformer(sbert_name)
sbert_tr = sbert_model.encode(
    X_tr_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
sbert_va = sbert_model.encode(
    X_va_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
sbert_te = sbert_model.encode(
    X_te_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
# Note: Sentence-BERT is a pretrained model with no training on this data,
# so encoding the full test set here is acceptable (no data leakage).
sbert_test = sbert_model.encode(
    X_test_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
print(f"S-BERT embedding dimension: {sbert_tr.shape[1]}")

# ============================================================
# 7. USE ONLY SBERT EMBEDDINGS (TF-IDF & stylometric features are not needed
#    since SBERT already captures semantics and style effectively)
# ============================================================
X_train = sbert_tr
X_val = sbert_va
X_test = sbert_te
X_final_test = sbert_test

print(
    f"Final feature matrix: Train {X_train.shape}, Val {X_val.shape}, Test {X_test.shape}"
)


# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.attention_block1 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2, dropout)
        self.attention_block2 = AttentionBlock(
            hidden_dim // 2, hidden_dim // 4, dropout
        )
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block1(x)
        x_attn = self.attention_block2(x)
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention_pool(x_attn), dim=1)
        x_weighted = x_attn * attention_weights
        logits = self.classifier(x_weighted)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)


# ============================================================
# SETUP DATA LOADERS (using all combined features)
# ============================================================
# Convert SBERT embeddings to dense tensors
X_train_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_train)
X_val_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_val)
X_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_test)
X_final_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_final_test)

y_train_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_tr)
y_val_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_va)
y_test_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_te)

batch_size = 1024
train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_tensor, y_train_tensor)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(X_val_tensor, y_val_tensor)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_test_tensor, y_test_tensor)
final_test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_final_test_tensor)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
final_test_loader = DataLoader(
    final_test_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=False,
)

# ============================================================
# INSTANTIATE MODEL, CRITERION, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

model = create_model(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)
criterion, optimizer = get_criterion_and_optimizer(
    model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01
)

num_epochs = 60
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience = 7
patience_counter = 0
best_model_state = None

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch_emb, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(batch_emb)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            val_labels.append(batch_labels.numpy())
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
    val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels, axis=0)
    val_loss = multiclass_log_loss(val_labels, val_preds)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND COMPUTE FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
model.eval()

val_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch_emb, _ in val_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
score = multiclass_log_loss(y_va, val_preds)
print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_val_loss:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# FINAL TEST INFERENCE FOR SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (batch_emb,) in final_test_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        final_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
final_preds = np.concatenate(final_preds, axis=0)
final_preds = final_preds / final_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": final_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_preds[:, 2],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.attention_block1 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2, dropout)
        self.attention_block2 = AttentionBlock(
            hidden_dim // 2, hidden_dim // 4, dropout
        )
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block1(x)
        x_attn = self.attention_block2(x)
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention_pool(x_attn), dim=1)
        x_weighted = x_attn * attention_weights
        logits = self.classifier(x_weighted)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )

# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer

# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

def clean_text(text):
    """Basic text cleaning - preserve authorial style by keeping punctuation"""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text


train_df["text_clean"] = train_df["text"].apply(clean_text)

# ==========================================

# ==========================================


# --- 3.1 Stylometric Features ---
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract author-specific writing style features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features = []
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        chars = len(text)
        word_count = len(words)

        # Basic counts
        avg_word_len = np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0
        avg_sent_len = np.mean([len(s.split()) for s in sentences]) if sentences else 0

        # Punctuation frequencies (normalized)
        punct_counts = {
            ",": text.count(","),
            ".": text.count("."),
            "!": text.count("!"),
            "?": text.count("?"),
            ";": text.count(";"),
            ":": text.count(":"),
            '"': text.count('"'),
            "'": text.count("'"),
            "-": text.count("-"),
            "—": text.count("—"),
            "(": text.count("("),
            ")": text.count(")"),
        }

        # Capitalization
        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(chars, 1)

        # Special patterns
        stopword_list = set(
            [
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "for",
                "of",
                "with",
                "by",
                "from",
                "up",
                "about",
                "into",
                "over",
                "after",
            ]
        )
        stopword_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stopword_list) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        # Unique words ratio (type-token ratio)
        unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        ttr = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)

        feat = [
            chars,  # 0: character count
            word_count,  # 1: word count
            len(sentences),  # 2: sentence count
            avg_word_len,  # 3: average word length
            avg_sent_len,  # 4: average sentence length (in words)
            upper_ratio,  # 5: uppercase ratio
            stopword_ratio,  # 6: stopword ratio
            ttr,  # 7: type-token ratio
            punct_counts[","],  # 8: comma count
            punct_counts["."],  # 9: period count
            punct_counts["!"],  # 10: exclamation count
            punct_counts["?"],  # 11: question count
            punct_counts[";"],  # 12: semicolon count
            punct_counts[":"],  # 13: colon count
            punct_counts['"'],  # 14: quote count
            punct_counts["'"],  # 15: apostrophe count
            punct_counts["-"],  # 16: hyphen count
            chars / max(word_count, 1),  # 17: avg characters per word
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

# --- 3.4 Part-of-Speech Tag Approximation Features ---
def extract_pos_features(texts):
    """Extract approximate POS distribution features using function word patterns"""
    features = []
    determiner_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(the|a|an|this|that|these|those|some|any|each|every)\b", re.I
    )
    preposition_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(in|on|at|to|for|with|by|from|up|about|into|over|after|before|under|above|between|through|during|without|within|along|among)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    conjunction_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(and|or|but|yet|so|nor|because|although|while|since|unless|if|when|where|whether)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    pronoun_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(I|you|he|she|it|we|they|me|him|her|us|them|my|your|his|its|our|their)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    auxiliary_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(am|is|are|was|were|been|being|have|has|had|do|does|did|will|would|shall|should|may|might|must|can|could)\b",
        re.I,
    )

    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 6)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        n_words = max(len(words), 1)

        determiners = len(determiner_pattern.findall(text))
        prepositions = len(preposition_pattern.findall(text))
        conjunctions = len(conjunction_pattern.findall(text))
        pronouns = len(pronoun_pattern.findall(text))
        auxiliaries = len(auxiliary_pattern.findall(text))

        # Ratio of punctuation as sentence boundary markers
        punct_ratio = (text.count(".") + text.count("!") + text.count("?")) / n_words

        features.append(
            [
                determiners / n_words,
                prepositions / n_words,
                conjunctions / n_words,
                pronouns / n_words,
                auxiliaries / n_words,
                punct_ratio,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)


print("Extracting POS approximation features...")

# --- 3.5 Readability and Text Complexity Features ---
def extract_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract readability metrics and text complexity features"""
    features = []

        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 4)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)

            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / n_words
            flesch = (
                206.835 - 1.015 * (n_words / n_sents) - 84.6 * (n_syllables / n_words)
            )
        else:
            flesch = 0

        long_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(n_words, 1)
        short_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 2) / max(n_words, 1)
        complexity = (
            (avg_word_len * 0.5 + (n_words / n_sents) * 0.5) if n_words > 0 else 0
        )

        features.append([flesch, long_word_ratio, short_word_ratio, complexity])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

# --- 3.1 Stylometric Features ---
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract author-specific writing style features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features = []
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        chars = len(text)
        word_count = len(words)

        # Basic counts
        avg_word_len = np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0
        avg_sent_len = np.mean([len(s.split()) for s in sentences]) if sentences else 0

        # Punctuation frequencies (normalized)
        punct_counts = {
            ",": text.count(","),
            ".": text.count("."),
            "!": text.count("!"),
            "?": text.count("?"),
            ";": text.count(";"),
            ":": text.count(":"),
            '"': text.count('"'),
            "'": text.count("'"),
            "-": text.count("-"),
            "—": text.count("—"),
            "(": text.count("("),
            ")": text.count(")"),
        }

        # Capitalization
        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(chars, 1)

        # Special patterns
        stopword_list = set(
            [
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "for",
                "of",
                "with",
                "by",
                "from",
                "up",
                "about",
                "into",
                "over",
                "after",
            ]
        )
        stopword_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stopword_list) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        # Unique words ratio (type-token ratio)
        unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        ttr = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)

        feat = [
            chars,  # 0: character count
            word_count,  # 1: word count
            len(sentences),  # 2: sentence count
            avg_word_len,  # 3: average word length
            avg_sent_len,  # 4: average sentence length (in words)
            upper_ratio,  # 5: uppercase ratio
            stopword_ratio,  # 6: stopword ratio
            ttr,  # 7: type-token ratio
            punct_counts[","],  # 8: comma count
            punct_counts["."],  # 9: period count
            punct_counts["!"],  # 10: exclamation count
            punct_counts["?"],  # 11: question count
            punct_counts[";"],  # 12: semicolon count
            punct_counts[":"],  # 13: colon count
            punct_counts['"'],  # 14: quote count
            punct_counts["'"],  # 15: apostrophe count
            punct_counts["-"],  # 16: hyphen count
            chars / max(word_count, 1),  # 17: avg characters per word
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def extract_pos_features(texts):
    """Extract approximate POS distribution features using function word patterns"""
    features = []
    determiner_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(the|a|an|this|that|these|those|some|any|each|every)\b", re.I
    )
    preposition_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(in|on|at|to|for|with|by|from|up|about|into|over|after|before|under|above|between|through|during|without|within|along|among)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    conjunction_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(and|or|but|yet|so|nor|because|although|while|since|unless|if|when|where|whether)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    pronoun_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(I|you|he|she|it|we|they|me|him|her|us|them|my|your|his|its|our|their)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    auxiliary_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(am|is|are|was|were|been|being|have|has|had|do|does|did|will|would|shall|should|may|might|must|can|could)\b",
        re.I,
    )

    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 6)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        n_words = max(len(words), 1)

        determiners = len(determiner_pattern.findall(text))
        prepositions = len(preposition_pattern.findall(text))
        conjunctions = len(conjunction_pattern.findall(text))
        pronouns = len(pronoun_pattern.findall(text))
        auxiliaries = len(auxiliary_pattern.findall(text))

        # Ratio of punctuation as sentence boundary markers
        punct_ratio = (text.count(".") + text.count("!") + text.count("?")) / n_words

        features.append(
            [
                determiners / n_words,
                prepositions / n_words,
                conjunctions / n_words,
                pronouns / n_words,
                auxiliaries / n_words,
                punct_ratio,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract readability metrics and text complexity features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 4)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]

        n_words = len(words)
        n_sents = max(len(sentences), 1)
        n_syllables = sum(1 for w in words for c in w.lower() if c in "aeiou")

        if n_words > 0 and n_sents > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / n_words
            flesch = (
                206.835 - 1.015 * (n_words / n_sents) - 84.6 * (n_syllables / n_words)
            )
        else:
            flesch = 0

        long_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(n_words, 1)
        short_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 2) / max(n_words, 1)
        complexity = (
            (avg_word_len * 0.5 + (n_words / n_sents) * 0.5) if n_words > 0 else 0
        )

        features.append([flesch, long_word_ratio, short_word_ratio, complexity])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def extract_length_features(texts):
    """Extract length-based features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0, 0, 0])

        words = text.split()
        n_chars = len(text)
        n_words = len(words)
        n_unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        features.append([n_chars, n_words, n_unique_words])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

        attention_mask = batch[1].to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
        labels = batch[2].to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
            )
            loss = outputs.loss

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    # Validation phase
    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            labels = batch[2].to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)

            with autocast():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
                )
                loss = outputs.loss
                logits = outputs.logits

            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    eps = 1e-15
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    val_probs_normalized = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(
        axis=1, keepdims=True
    )

        np.sum(np.eye(NUM_LABELS)[val_true] * np.log(val_probs_normalized), axis=1)
    )

    )

    else:

        paren_count = (text.count("(") + text.count(")")) / max(char_count, 1)

# 10. FOCAL LOSS
# ============================================================
class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, alpha=None, reduction="mean"):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, input, target):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(input, target, reduction="none", weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return focal_loss.sum()
        else:
            return focal_loss

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, alpha=None, reduction="mean"):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, input, target):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(input, target, reduction="none", weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return focal_loss.sum()
        else:
            return focal_loss

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from transformers import get_linear_schedule_with_warmup
import os
import re
import joblib
import warnings
import nlpaug.augmenter.word as naw

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train_text = train_df["text"].values
y_author = train_df["author"].values
X_test_text = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = label_encoder.fit_transform(y_author)
num_classes = len(label_encoder.classes_)

# ============================================================
# 2. STRATIFIED SPLIT (70% train, 15% val, 15% test from train)
# ============================================================
X_tr_text, X_va_text, y_tr, y_va = train_test_split(
    X_train_text, y_encoded, test_size=0.3, stratify=y_encoded, random_state=42
)
X_va_text, X_te_text, y_va, y_te = train_test_split(
    X_va_text, y_va, test_size=0.5, stratify=y_va, random_state=42
)

print(f"Train: {len(X_tr_text)}, Val: {len(X_va_text)}, Test: {len(X_te_text)}")


# ============================================================
# 3. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Syntactic/Stylometric Features
# ============================================================
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        text_str = str(text)
        words = text_str.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        feat = [
            len(text_str),
            len(words),
            len(sentences),
            np.mean([len(s) for s in sentences]) if sentences else 0,
            np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0,
            text_str.count(",") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(".") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("!") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("?") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(";") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count(":") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count('"') / max(1, len(text_str)),
            text_str.count("'") / max(1, len(text_str)),
            sum(c.isupper() for c in text_str) / max(1, len(text_str)),
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)


print("Extracting stylometric features...")
stylo_tr = extract_stylometric_features(X_tr_text)
stylo_va = extract_stylometric_features(X_va_text)
stylo_te = extract_stylometric_features(X_te_text)
stylo_test = extract_stylometric_features(X_test_text)

scaler_stylo = StandardScaler()
stylo_tr = scaler_stylo.fit_transform(stylo_tr)
stylo_va = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_va)
stylo_te = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_te)
stylo_test = scaler_stylo.transform(stylo_test)

# ============================================================
# 4. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Character n-gram TF-IDF
# ============================================================
print("Extracting character n-gram features...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
)
char_tr = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr_text)
char_va = char_vectorizer.transform(X_va_text)
char_te = char_vectorizer.transform(X_te_text)
char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# ============================================================
# 5. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Word-level TF-IDF
# ============================================================
print("Extracting word-level features...")
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=5000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    stop_words=None,
)
word_tr = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr_text)
word_va = word_vectorizer.transform(X_va_text)
word_te = word_vectorizer.transform(X_te_text)
word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# ============================================================
# 6. FEATURE ENGINEERING - Sentence-BERT Embeddings
# ============================================================
print("Extracting Sentence-BERT embeddings...")
sbert_name = "all-mpnet-base-v2"
sbert_model = SentenceTransformer(sbert_name)
sbert_tr = sbert_model.encode(
    X_tr_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
sbert_va = sbert_model.encode(
    X_va_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
sbert_te = sbert_model.encode(
    X_te_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
# Note: Sentence-BERT is a pretrained model with no training on this data,
# so encoding the full test set here is acceptable (no data leakage).
sbert_test = sbert_model.encode(
    X_test_text.tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
)
print(f"S-BERT embedding dimension: {sbert_tr.shape[1]}")

# ============================================================
# DATA AUGMENTATION: Synonym Augmentation on Training Text
# ============================================================
print("Augmenting training data with synonyms...")
augmenter = naw.SynonymAug(aug_src='wordnet', aug_p=0.3, aug_min=1, aug_max=None)
X_tr_text_aug = []
y_tr_aug = []
for text, label in zip(X_tr_text, y_tr):
    # Augment the text with 20% of words changed
    try:
        augmented_text = augmenter.augment(str(text), n=1)
        if isinstance(augmented_text, list):
            augmented_text = augmented_text[0]
        X_tr_text_aug.append(augmented_text)
        y_tr_aug.append(label)
    except:
        # If augmentation fails, skip this sample
        pass

if len(X_tr_text_aug) > 0:
    # Combine original and augmented texts
    X_tr_combined = np.concatenate([X_tr_text, np.array(X_tr_text_aug)])
    y_tr_combined = np.concatenate([y_tr, np.array(y_tr_aug)])
    # Encode augmented texts with SBERT
    sbert_tr_aug = sbert_model.encode(
        np.array(X_tr_text_aug).tolist(), convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False
    )
    # Combine embeddings
    sbert_tr = np.concatenate([sbert_tr, sbert_tr_aug], axis=0)
    y_tr = y_tr_combined
    print(f"Training set size after augmentation: {sbert_tr.shape[0]}")
else:
    print("Warning: Augmentation produced no samples, using original data")

# ============================================================
# 7. USE ONLY SBERT EMBEDDINGS (TF-IDF & stylometric features are not needed
#    since SBERT already captures semantics and style effectively)
# ============================================================
X_train = sbert_tr
X_val = sbert_va
X_test = sbert_te
X_final_test = sbert_test

print(
    f"Final feature matrix: Train {X_train.shape}, Val {X_val.shape}, Test {X_test.shape}"
)


# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        # Multi-scale branches: half, quarter, eighth of hidden_dim
        self.branch1 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, 256, dropout)
        self.branch2 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, 128, dropout)
        self.branch3 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, 64, dropout)
        # Gating mechanism: learn weights for combining scales
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 128 + 64, 3),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(256 + 128 + 64, 1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 128 + 64, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        # Multi-scale branches
        out1 = self.branch1(x)
        out2 = self.branch2(x)
        out3 = self.branch3(x)
        # Concatenate for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat([out1, out2, out3], dim=-1)
        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # [batch, 3]
        # Weighted combination
        weighted = gate_weights[:, 0:1] * out1 + gate_weights[:, 1:2] * out2 + gate_weights[:, 2:3] * out3
        # Attention pooling on concatenated features
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention_pool(concat_out), dim=1)
        x_weighted = concat_out * attention_weights
        # Combine gated output with attention-weighted output
        x_combined = weighted + x_weighted
        logits = self.classifier(x_combined)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)


# ============================================================
# SETUP DATA LOADERS (using all combined features)
# ============================================================
# Convert SBERT embeddings to dense tensors
X_train_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_train)
X_val_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_val)
X_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_test)
X_final_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_final_test)

y_train_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_tr)
y_val_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_va)
y_test_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_te)

batch_size = 1024
train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_tensor, y_train_tensor)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(X_val_tensor, y_val_tensor)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_test_tensor, y_test_tensor)
final_test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_final_test_tensor)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
final_test_loader = DataLoader(
    final_test_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=False,
)

# ============================================================
# INSTANTIATE MODEL, CRITERION, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

model = create_model(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)
criterion, optimizer = get_criterion_and_optimizer(
    model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01
)

num_epochs = 60
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience = 7
patience_counter = 0
best_model_state = None

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch_emb, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(batch_emb)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            val_labels.append(batch_labels.numpy())
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
    val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels, axis=0)
    val_loss = multiclass_log_loss(val_labels, val_preds)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND COMPUTE FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
model.eval()

val_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch_emb, _ in val_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
score = multiclass_log_loss(y_va, val_preds)
print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_val_loss:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# FINAL TEST INFERENCE FOR SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (batch_emb,) in final_test_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        final_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
final_preds = np.concatenate(final_preds, axis=0)
final_preds = final_preds / final_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": final_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_preds[:, 2],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# Task description
# Overview

## Description

As I scurried across the candlelit chamber, manuscripts in hand, I thought I'd made it. Nothing would be able to hurt me anymore. Little did I know there was one last fright lurking around the corner.

DING! My phone pinged me with a disturbing notification. It was Will, the scariest of Kaggle moderators, sharing news of another data leak.

How will I ever figure out how to put them back together according to the authors who wrote them? Or are they lost, forevermore? Wait, I thought... I know, machine learning!

In this year's Halloween playground competition, you're challenged to predict the author of excerpts from horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Mary Shelley, and HP Lovecraft.

### Getting Started

New to Kernels or working with natural language data? We've put together some starter kernels in Python and R to help you hit the ground running.

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

### Submission File

You must submit a csv file with the id, and a probability for each of the three classes. The order of the rows does not matter. The file must have a header and should look like the following:

# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier

class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.attention_block1 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2, dropout)
        self.attention_block2 = AttentionBlock(
            hidden_dim // 2, hidden_dim // 4, dropout
        )
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block1(x)
        x_attn = self.attention_block2(x)
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention_pool(x_attn), dim=1)
        x_weighted = x_attn * attention_weights
        logits = self.classifier(x_weighted)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):

    )

# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer

# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS

def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

import numpy as np

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import warnings
import pickle
from scipy.sparse import save_npz

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
print("Loading data...")

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# ============================================================
# 2. DATA CLEANING

def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = text.replace('"', "'")
    text = text.replace("`", "'")
    text = text.replace("&", "and")
    text = re.sub(r"\.{3,}", "...", text)
    text = re.sub(r"--+", "—", text)
    text = text.strip()
    return text


train_df["text_clean"] = train_df["text"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["text_clean"] = test_df["text"].apply(clean_text)

train_df = train_df[train_df["text_clean"].str.len() > 0].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = test_df[test_df["text_clean"].str.len() > 0].reset_index(drop=True)

# ============================================================
# 3. ENCODE TARGET
# ============================================================
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
train_df["author_encoded"] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["author"])
author_mapping = dict(zip(label_encoder.classes_, range(len(label_encoder.classes_))))
print(f"Author mapping: {author_mapping}")

# ============================================================
# 4. STRATIFIED TRAIN/VAL/TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================
X_train_full = train_df["text_clean"].values
y_train_full = train_df["author_encoded"].values

X_train, X_temp, y_train, y_temp = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train_full, random_state=42
)

    X_temp, y_temp, test_size=0.5, stratify=y_temp, random_state=42

print(f"Train size: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Val size: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Test (holdout) size: {len(X_test_holdout)}")
print(f"Full test (competition) size: {len(test_df)}")


# ============================================================
# 5. FEATURE ENGINEERING - TEXT STATISTICS (for potential future use)
# ============================================================
def extract_text_statistics(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        num_chars = len(text)
        num_words = len(words)
        num_sentences = max(len(sentences), 1)
        num_unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        word_lengths = [len(w) for w in words]
        avg_word_length = np.mean(word_lengths) if word_lengths else 0
        std_word_length = np.std(word_lengths) if word_lengths else 0
        max_word_length = max(word_lengths) if word_lengths else 0
        sentence_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        avg_sentence_length = np.mean(sentence_lengths)
        std_sentence_length = np.std(sentence_lengths)
        num_commas = text.count(",")
        num_periods = text.count(".")
        num_exclamations = text.count("!")
        num_questions = text.count("?")
        num_semicolons = text.count(";")
        num_colons = text.count(":")
        num_quotes = text.count('"') + text.count("'")
        num_dashes = text.count("—") + text.count("-")
        num_parentheses = text.count("(") + text.count(")")
        uppercase_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(num_chars, 1)
        digit_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / max(num_chars, 1)
        whitespace_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isspace()) / max(num_chars, 1)
        ttr = num_unique_words / max(num_words, 1)
        word_freq = {}
        for w in words:
            w_lower = w.lower()
            word_freq[w_lower] = word_freq.get(w_lower, 0) + 1
        hapax_count = sum(1 for v in word_freq.values() if v == 1)
        hapax_ratio = hapax_count / max(num_words, 1)
        punct_features = [
            num_commas / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_periods / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_exclamations / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_questions / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_semicolons / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_colons / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_quotes / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_dashes / max(num_chars, 1),
            num_parentheses / max(num_chars, 1),
        ]
        contraction_patterns = [
            r"\b\w+n't\b",
            r"\b\w+'ve\b",
            r"\b\w+'re\b",
            r"\b\w+'ll\b",
            r"\b\w+'d\b",
            r"\b\w+'m\b",
            r"\b\w+'s\b",
        ]
        num_contractions = sum(len(re.findall(p, text)) for p in contraction_patterns)
        contraction_ratio = num_contractions / max(num_words, 1)
        features.append(
            [
                num_chars,
                num_words,
                num_sentences,
                num_unique_words,
                avg_word_length,
                std_word_length,
                max_word_length,
                avg_sentence_length,
                std_sentence_length,
                uppercase_ratio,
                digit_ratio,
                whitespace_ratio,
                ttr,
                hapax_ratio,
                *punct_features,
                num_contractions,
                contraction_ratio,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)


# ============================================================
# 6. TOKENIZATION FOR TRANSFORMER MODEL
# ============================================================
print("Preparing tokenization...")
model_name = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
max_length = 512


def tokenize_texts(texts, tokenizer, max_length=512):
    return tokenizer(
        texts.tolist(),
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        max_length=max_length,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )


train_tokenized = tokenize_texts(X_train, tokenizer, max_length)
val_tokenized = tokenize_texts(X_val, tokenizer, max_length)
test_tokenized = tokenize_texts(test_df["text_clean"].values, tokenizer, max_length)

# ============================================================
# 7. MODEL DEFINITION: DeBERTa for Authorship
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
num_authors = 3


class DebertaForAuthorship(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, model_name="microsoft/deberta-v3-large", num_labels=3, dropout=0.2
    ):
        super().__init__()
        from transformers import AutoConfig

        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.num_labels = num_labels
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(self.config.hidden_size, num_labels)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=False,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        pooled = self.dropout(pooled)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        return logits


# ============================================================
# 8. LOSS FUNCTION: Label Smoothing Cross-Entropy
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.1, reduction="mean"):
        super().__init__()
        self.epsilon = epsilon
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            smooth_targets = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            smooth_targets.fill_(self.epsilon / (num_classes - 1))
            smooth_targets.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.epsilon)
        loss = -torch.sum(smooth_targets * log_probs, dim=-1)
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return loss.sum()
        return loss


# ============================================================
# 9. INITIALIZE MODEL, LOSS, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
model = DebertaForAuthorship(model_name=model_name, num_labels=num_authors, dropout=0.2)
model.to(device)
criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(epsilon=0.1)

# ============================================================
# 10. PREPARE DATA LOADERS
# ============================================================
batch_size = 16

train_dataset = TensorDataset(
    train_tokenized["input_ids"],
    train_tokenized["attention_mask"],
    torch.tensor(y_train, dtype=torch.long),
)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(
    val_tokenized["input_ids"],
    val_tokenized["attention_mask"],
    torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.long),
)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(
    test_tokenized["input_ids"], test_tokenized["attention_mask"]
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)

# ============================================================
# 11. TRAINING CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
epochs = 40
total_steps = len(train_loader) * epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)

optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)

scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# 12. TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_logloss = float("inf")
patience = 5
patience_counter = 0

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    for batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_input_ids = batch_input_ids.to(device)
        batch_attention_mask = batch_attention_mask.to(device)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
            logits = model(batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_losses = []
    all_val_preds = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_input_ids = batch_input_ids.to(device)
            batch_attention_mask = batch_attention_mask.to(device)
            batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device)

            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
                logits = model(batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
                probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            val_losses.append(loss.item())
            all_val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(batch_labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / len(train_loader)
    avg_val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
    val_preds = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_preds_clipped = np.clip(val_preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_preds_clipped)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_logloss:.6f}"
    )

    if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
        best_val_logloss = val_logloss
        patience_counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# ============================================================
# 13. LOAD BEST MODEL AND COMPUTE FINAL VALIDATION
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()

all_val_preds = []
all_val_labels = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask, batch_labels in val_loader:
        batch_input_ids = batch_input_ids.to(device)
        batch_attention_mask = batch_attention_mask.to(device)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device)
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
            logits = model(batch_input_ids, batch_attention_mask)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(batch_labels.cpu().numpy())

val_preds_final = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
val_true_final = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

import pandas as pd

import torch

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA

train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train_text = train_df["text"].values

X_test_text = test_df["text"].values
