# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        # Single branch with fixed dimension (no dimension mismatch)
        self.attention_block = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, 256, dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block(x)
        logits = self.classifier(x)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=384, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)


# ============================================================
# SETUP DATA LOADERS (using all combined features)
# ============================================================
# Convert SBERT embeddings to dense tensors
X_train_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_train)
X_val_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_val)
X_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_test)
X_final_test_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(X_final_test)

y_train_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_tr)
y_val_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_va)
y_test_tensor = torch.LongTensor(y_te)

batch_size = 1024
train_dataset = TensorDataset(X_train_tensor, y_train_tensor)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(X_val_tensor, y_val_tensor)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_test_tensor, y_test_tensor)
final_test_dataset = TensorDataset(X_final_test_tensor)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0, pin_memory=False
)
final_test_loader = DataLoader(
    final_test_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=False,
)

# ============================================================
# INSTANTIATE MODEL, CRITERION, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

model = create_model(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)
criterion, optimizer = get_criterion_and_optimizer(
    model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01
)

num_epochs = 60
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience = 7
patience_counter = 0
best_model_state = None

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch_emb, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(batch_emb)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            val_labels.append(batch_labels.numpy())
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
    val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels, axis=0)
    val_loss = multiclass_log_loss(val_labels, val_preds)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND COMPUTE FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
model.eval()

val_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch_emb, _ in val_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
score = multiclass_log_loss(y_va, val_preds)
print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_val_loss:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# FINAL TEST INFERENCE FOR SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (batch_emb,) in final_test_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        final_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
final_preds = np.concatenate(final_preds, axis=0)
final_preds = final_preds / final_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": final_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_preds[:, 2],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# MODEL DEFINITION: Hierarchical Attention Classifier
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        # Single branch with fixed dimension (no dimension mismatch)
        self.attention_block = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, 256, dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block(x)
        logits = self.classifier(x)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )

# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer

def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract author-specific writing style features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:

            features = []

        words = text.split()

        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        chars = len(text)

        # Basic counts

        avg_sent_len = np.mean([len(s.split()) for s in sentences]) if sentences else 0

        # Punctuation frequencies (normalized)

            ",": text.count(","),
            ".": text.count("."),

            ":": text.count(":"),
            '"': text.count('"'),
            "'": text.count("'"),
            "-": text.count("-"),
            "—": text.count("—"),
            "(": text.count("("),
            ")": text.count(")"),
        }

        # Capitalization
        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(chars, 1)

        # Special patterns
        stopword_list = set(
            [
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "for",
                "of",
                "with",
                "by",
                "from",
                "up",
                "about",
                "into",
                "over",
                "after",
            ]
        )
        stopword_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stopword_list) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        # Unique words ratio (type-token ratio)
        unique_words = len(set(w.lower() for w in words))
        ttr = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)

        feat = [
            chars,  # 0: character count
            word_count,  # 1: word count
            len(sentences),  # 2: sentence count
            avg_word_len,  # 3: average word length
            avg_sent_len,  # 4: average sentence length (in words)
            upper_ratio,  # 5: uppercase ratio
            stopword_ratio,  # 6: stopword ratio
            ttr,  # 7: type-token ratio
            punct_counts[","],  # 8: comma count
            punct_counts["."],  # 9: period count
            punct_counts["!"],  # 10: exclamation count
            punct_counts["?"],  # 11: question count
            punct_counts[";"],  # 12: semicolon count
            punct_counts[":"],  # 13: colon count
            punct_counts['"'],  # 14: quote count
            punct_counts["'"],  # 15: apostrophe count
            punct_counts["-"],  # 16: hyphen count
            chars / max(word_count, 1),  # 17: avg characters per word
        ]
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

        r"\b(and|or|but|yet|so|nor|because|although|while|since|unless|if|when|where|whether)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    pronoun_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(I|you|he|she|it|we|they|me|him|her|us|them|my|your|his|its|our|their)\b",
        re.I,
    )
    auxiliary_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(am|is|are|was|were|been|being|have|has|had|do|does|did|will|would|shall|should|may|might|must|can|could)\b",
        re.I,
    )

    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 6)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        n_words = max(len(words), 1)

        determiners = len(determiner_pattern.findall(text))
        prepositions = len(preposition_pattern.findall(text))
        conjunctions = len(conjunction_pattern.findall(text))
        pronouns = len(pronoun_pattern.findall(text))
        auxiliaries = len(auxiliary_pattern.findall(text))

        # Ratio of punctuation as sentence boundary markers
        punct_ratio = (text.count(".") + text.count("!") + text.count("?")) / n_words

        features.append(
            [
                determiners / n_words,
                prepositions / n_words,
                conjunctions / n_words,
                pronouns / n_words,
                auxiliaries / n_words,
                punct_ratio,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def extract_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract readability metrics and text complexity features"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            features.append([0] * 4)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]

        n_words = len(words)
        n_sents = max(len(sentences), 1)
        n_syllables = sum(1 for w in words for c in w.lower() if c in "aeiou")

        if n_words > 0 and n_sents > 0:
            avg_word_len = sum(len(w) for w in words) / n_words
            flesch = (
                206.835 - 1.015 * (n_words / n_sents) - 84.6 * (n_syllables / n_words)
            )
        else:
            flesch = 0

        long_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(n_words, 1)
        short_word_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 2) / max(n_words, 1)
        complexity = (
            (avg_word_len * 0.5 + (n_words / n_sents) * 0.5) if n_words > 0 else 0
        )

        features.append([flesch, long_word_ratio, short_word_ratio, complexity])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def extract_char_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """Extract character n-grams (2-5 grams) that capture morphology and punctuation patterns."""
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            max_features=15000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            min_df=5,
            max_df=0.8,
        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(texts)


def extract_word_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """Extract word n-grams (1-3 grams) that capture vocabulary and phrase patterns."""
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            max_features=15000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            min_df=5,
            max_df=0.8,
            stop_words=None,
        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(texts)


def extract_pos_patterns(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """
    Extract POS tag n-grams to capture syntactic patterns.
    Using a simple heuristic: tag words based on suffixes and patterns.
    """

    def tag_sentence(text):
        words = text.split()
        tags = []
        for w in words:
            w_clean = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not w_clean:
                tags.append("PUNCT")
            elif w_clean in ["the", "a", "an"]:
                tags.append("DET")
            elif w_clean in ["is", "am", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being"]:
                tags.append("VERB_BE")
            elif w_clean in ["have", "has", "had", "having"]:
                tags.append("VERB_HAVE")
            elif w_clean in ["do", "does", "did", "doing", "done"]:
                tags.append("VERB_DO")
            elif w_clean in [
                "will",
                "would",
                "can",
                "could",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "may",
                "might",
                "must",
            ]:
                tags.append("MODAL")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ing"):
                tags.append("VBG")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ed"):
                tags.append("VBD")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ly"):
                tags.append("ADV")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("tion")
                or w_clean.endswith("sion")
                or w_clean.endswith("ment")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("ness")
                or w_clean.endswith("ity")
                or w_clean.endswith("ship")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("able")
                or w_clean.endswith("ible")
                or w_clean.endswith("ful")
            ):
                tags.append("ADJ")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("ous")
                or w_clean.endswith("ive")
                or w_clean.endswith("al")
            ):
                tags.append("ADJ")
            elif w_clean.endswith("s") and len(w_clean) > 2:
                tags.append("NNS")
            elif len(w_clean) <= 3 and w_clean.isalpha():
                tags.append("FUNC")
            elif w_clean[0].isupper() and len(w_clean) > 1:
                tags.append("NNP")
            else:
                tags.append("OTHER")
        return " ".join(tags)

    pos_texts = [tag_sentence(t) for t in texts]

    if fit:
        vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=5000, min_df=3, max_df=0.9
        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(pos_texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(pos_texts)

class MLPClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes, dropout_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 128)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(128, num_classes)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc1(x)))
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc2(x)))
        x = self.fc3(x)
        return x

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (num_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(classifier.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    classifier.eval()

    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_targets = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            logits = classifier(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1

            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_targets.append(batch_labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches

    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_targets = np.concatenate(all_val_targets, axis=0)

    epsilon = 1e-15
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    row_sums = val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_probs_normalized = val_probs_clipped / row_sums
    val_probs_normalized = np.clip(val_probs_normalized, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    row_sums = val_probs_normalized.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_probs_normalized = val_probs_normalized / row_sums

    val_log_loss = log_loss(val_targets, val_probs_normalized)

It engineers (1) 18 sentence-level statistical features (punctuation frequencies, capitalization ratios, function-word density, etc.), (2) character TF-IDF n-grams (2-5), (3) word TF-IDF n-grams (1-3), and (4) POS tag count n-grams (2-4) via a suffix-based heuristic tagger — all combined into a sparse matrix (~35k features). It also extracts frozen 768-dim sentence embeddings using SentenceTransformer's all-mpnet-base-v2 model. A 3-layer MLP (768→256→128→3) with ReLU, dropout (0.2), Xavier init, label smoothing (0.1) and Adam (lr=2e-5, weight_decay=1e-4) is trained for up to 60 epochs with early stopping (patience 7) on validation log-loss. The best model is used to generate test predictions and a submission CSV.

def extract_char_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """Extract character n-grams (2-5 grams) that capture morphology and punctuation patterns."""
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            max_features=15000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            min_df=5,
            max_df=0.8,
        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(texts)


def extract_word_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """Extract word n-grams (1-3 grams) that capture vocabulary and phrase patterns."""
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="word",
            ngram_range=(1, 3),
            max_features=15000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            min_df=5,
            max_df=0.8,
            stop_words=None,
        )

        return features, vectorizer
    else:

    def tag_sentence(text):
        words = text.split()
        tags = []
        for w in words:
            w_clean = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not w_clean:
                tags.append("PUNCT")
            elif w_clean in ["the", "a", "an"]:
                tags.append("DET")
            elif w_clean in ["is", "am", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being"]:
                tags.append("VERB_BE")
            elif w_clean in ["have", "has", "had", "having"]:
                tags.append("VERB_HAVE")
            elif w_clean in ["do", "does", "did", "doing", "done"]:
                tags.append("VERB_DO")
            elif w_clean in [
                "will",
                "would",
                "can",
                "could",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "may",
                "might",
                "must",
            ]:
                tags.append("MODAL")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ing"):
                tags.append("VBG")

    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes, dropout_rate):

                if m.bias is not None:

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.fc3(x)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (num_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

    def tag_sentence(text):
        words = text.split()
        tags = []
        for w in words:
            w_clean = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not w_clean:
                tags.append("PUNCT")
            elif w_clean in ["the", "a", "an"]:
                tags.append("DET")
            elif w_clean in ["is", "am", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being"]:
                tags.append("VERB_BE")
            elif w_clean in ["have", "has", "had", "having"]:
                tags.append("VERB_HAVE")
            elif w_clean in ["do", "does", "did", "doing", "done"]:
                tags.append("VERB_DO")
            elif w_clean in [
                "will",
                "would",
                "can",
                "could",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "may",
                "might",
                "must",
            ]:
                tags.append("MODAL")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ing"):
                tags.append("VBG")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ed"):
                tags.append("VBD")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ly"):
                tags.append("ADV")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("tion")
                or w_clean.endswith("sion")
                or w_clean.endswith("ment")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("ness")
                or w_clean.endswith("ity")
                or w_clean.endswith("ship")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("able")

            elif (

            elif w_clean.endswith("s") and len(w_clean) > 2:

            elif len(w_clean) <= 3 and w_clean.isalpha():
                tags.append("FUNC")
            elif w_clean[0].isupper() and len(w_clean) > 1:
                tags.append("NNP")
            else:

        return " ".join(tags)

# 11. TRAINING SETUP
# ============================================================

val_labels = torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.long).to(device)

)


class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (num_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)

    total_val_loss = 0

    all_val_probs = []

    f"Final feature matrix: Train {X_train.shape}, Val {X_val.shape}, Test {X_test.shape}"
)


# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Multi-Branch Attention Classifier with Gating
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        # Three parallel branches with different hidden dimensions
        branch_dims = [256, 128, 64]
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(input_dim, branch_dim),
                AttentionBlock(branch_dim, branch_dim, dropout),
            )
            for branch_dim in branch_dims
        ])
        # Pooling layers for each branch
        self.pools = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) for _ in branch_dims
        ])
        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), len(branch_dims)),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process through each branch
        branch_outputs = []
        for branch in self.branches:
            branch_out = branch(x)  # (batch, branch_dim)
            branch_outputs.append(branch_out)

        # Concatenate branch outputs for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat(branch_outputs, dim=1)  # (batch, sum_dims)

        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # (batch, num_branches)

        # Apply gating to each branch output
        gated_outputs = []
        for i, branch_out in enumerate(branch_outputs):
            weight = gate_weights[:, i:i+1]  # (batch, 1)
            gated_outputs.append(branch_out * weight)

        # Concatenate gated outputs
        final_rep = torch.cat(gated_outputs, dim=1)

        # Classify
        logits = self.classifier(final_rep)
        return logits

class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class HierarchicalAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.attention_block1 = AttentionBlock(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2, dropout)
        self.attention_block2 = AttentionBlock(
            hidden_dim // 2, hidden_dim // 4, dropout
        )
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 4, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        x = self.attention_block1(x)
        x_attn = self.attention_block2(x)
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention_pool(x_attn), dim=1)
        x_weighted = x_attn * attention_weights
        logits = self.classifier(x_weighted)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):

        input_dim=768, hidden_dim=512, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15

# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Multi-Branch Attention Classifier with Gating
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        # Three parallel branches with different hidden dimensions
        branch_dims = [256, 128, 64]
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(input_dim, branch_dim),
                AttentionBlock(branch_dim, branch_dim, dropout),
            )
            for branch_dim in branch_dims
        ])
        # Pooling layers for each branch
        self.pools = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) for _ in branch_dims
        ])
        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), len(branch_dims)),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process through each branch
        branch_outputs = []
        for branch in self.branches:
            branch_out = branch(x)  # (batch, branch_dim)
            branch_outputs.append(branch_out)

        # Concatenate branch outputs for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat(branch_outputs, dim=1)  # (batch, sum_dims)

        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # (batch, num_branches)

        # Apply gating to each branch output
        gated_outputs = []
        for i, branch_out in enumerate(branch_outputs):
            weight = gate_weights[:, i:i+1]  # (batch, 1)
            gated_outputs.append(branch_out * weight)

        # Concatenate gated outputs
        final_rep = torch.cat(gated_outputs, dim=1)

        # Classify
        logits = self.classifier(final_rep)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=False,
)

# ============================================================
# INSTANTIATE MODEL, CRITERION, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

model = create_model(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)

num_epochs = 60
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience = 7
patience_counter = 0
best_model_state = None

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch_emb, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(batch_emb)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            val_labels.append(batch_labels.numpy())
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds, axis=0)
    val_labels = np.concatenate(val_labels, axis=0)
    val_loss = multiclass_log_loss(val_labels, val_preds)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        best_model_state = model.state_dict().copy()
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND COMPUTE FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
model.eval()

val_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch_emb, _ in val_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_val_loss:.6f}")

# FINAL TEST INFERENCE FOR SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for (batch_emb,) in final_test_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        final_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
final_preds = np.concatenate(final_preds, axis=0)
final_preds = final_preds / final_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": final_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_preds[:, 2],
    }
)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        # Three parallel branches with different hidden dimensions
        branch_dims = [256, 128, 64]
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(input_dim, branch_dim),
                AttentionBlock(branch_dim, branch_dim, dropout),
            )
            for branch_dim in branch_dims
        ])
        # Pooling layers for each branch
        self.pools = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) for _ in branch_dims
        ])
        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), len(branch_dims)),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process through each branch
        branch_outputs = []
        for branch in self.branches:
            branch_out = branch(x)  # (batch, branch_dim)
            branch_outputs.append(branch_out)

        # Concatenate branch outputs for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat(branch_outputs, dim=1)  # (batch, sum_dims)

        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # (batch, num_branches)

        # Apply gating to each branch output
        gated_outputs = []
        for i, branch_out in enumerate(branch_outputs):
            weight = gate_weights[:, i:i+1]  # (batch, 1)
            gated_outputs.append(branch_out * weight)

        # Concatenate gated outputs
        final_rep = torch.cat(gated_outputs, dim=1)

        # Classify
        logits = self.classifier(final_rep)
        return logits

# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer

def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

        branch_dims = [256, 128, 64]
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(input_dim, branch_dim),
                AttentionBlock(branch_dim, branch_dim, dropout),
            )
            for branch_dim in branch_dims
        ])
        # Pooling layers for each branch
        self.pools = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) for _ in branch_dims
        ])
        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), len(branch_dims)),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process through each branch
        branch_outputs = []
        for branch in self.branches:
            branch_out = branch(x)  # (batch, branch_dim)
            branch_outputs.append(branch_out)

        # Concatenate branch outputs for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat(branch_outputs, dim=1)  # (batch, sum_dims)

        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # (batch, num_branches)

        # Apply gating to each branch output
        gated_outputs = []
        for i, branch_out in enumerate(branch_outputs):
            weight = gate_weights[:, i:i+1]  # (batch, 1)
            gated_outputs.append(branch_out * weight)

        # Concatenate gated outputs
        final_rep = torch.cat(gated_outputs, dim=1)

        # Classify
        logits = self.classifier(final_rep)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)


# ============================================================
# SETUP DATA LOADERS (using all combined features)
# ============================================================

val_dataset = TensorDataset(X_val_tensor, y_val_tensor)

)
test_loader = DataLoader(

)
final_test_loader = DataLoader(
    final_test_dataset,

    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=False,
)

# ============================================================
# INSTANTIATE MODEL, CRITERION, OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

model = create_model(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)
criterion, optimizer = get_criterion_and_optimizer(
    model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01
)

num_epochs = 60
total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience = 7
patience_counter = 0
best_model_state = None

print("Starting training...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch_emb, batch_labels in train_loader:
        batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(batch_emb)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    model.eval()
    val_preds = []
    val_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_emb, batch_labels in val_loader:
            batch_emb = batch_emb.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        final_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
final_preds = np.concatenate(final_preds, axis=0)
final_preds = final_preds / final_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    {

        "EAP": final_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_preds[:, 2],
    }
)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION: Multi-Branch Attention Classifier with Gating
# ============================================================
class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(input_dim)
        self.attention_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(output_dim * 2, output_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        if input_dim != output_dim:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        else:
            self.residual_proj = nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out = self.attention_proj(self.norm1(x))
        x = attn_out + self.residual_proj(x)
        ffn_out = self.ffn(self.norm2(x))
        x = ffn_out + x
        return x


class MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=768, num_classes=3, dropout=0.15):
        super().__init__()
        # Three parallel branches with different hidden dimensions
        branch_dims = [256, 128, 64]
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(input_dim, branch_dim),
                AttentionBlock(branch_dim, branch_dim, dropout),
            )
            for branch_dim in branch_dims
        ])
        # Pooling layers for each branch
        self.pools = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1) for _ in branch_dims
        ])
        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), len(branch_dims)),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sum(branch_dims), 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout * 0.5),
            nn.Linear(64, num_classes),
        )
        self.apply(self._init_weights)

    def _init_weights(self, module):
        if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=1.0)
            if module.bias is not None:
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process through each branch
        branch_outputs = []
        for branch in self.branches:
            branch_out = branch(x)  # (batch, branch_dim)
            branch_outputs.append(branch_out)

        # Concatenate branch outputs for gating
        concat_out = torch.cat(branch_outputs, dim=1)  # (batch, sum_dims)

        # Compute gating weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(concat_out)  # (batch, num_branches)

        # Apply gating to each branch output
        gated_outputs = []
        for i, branch_out in enumerate(branch_outputs):
            weight = gate_weights[:, i:i+1]  # (batch, 1)
            gated_outputs.append(branch_out * weight)

        # Concatenate gated outputs
        final_rep = torch.cat(gated_outputs, dim=1)

        # Classify
        logits = self.classifier(final_rep)
        return logits


def create_model(num_classes=3):
    return MultiBranchAttentionClassifier(
        input_dim=768, num_classes=num_classes, dropout=0.15
    )


# ============================================================
# LOSS FUNCTION WITH LABEL SMOOTHING
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(pred)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (pred.size(-1) - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))


def get_criterion_and_optimizer(model, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01):
    criterion = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=0.1)
    no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "LayerNorm.bias", "norm"]
    optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": weight_decay,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
            ],
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
        },
    ]
    optimizer = AdamW(
        optimizer_grouped_parameters, lr=learning_rate, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8
    )
    return criterion, optimizer


# ============================================================
# MULTICLASS LOG LOSS
# ============================================================
def multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_probs, eps=1e-15):
    y_pred_probs = np.clip(y_pred_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_probs = y_pred_probs / row_sums
    y_true_one_hot = np.zeros_like(y_pred_probs)
    y_true_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(y_pred_probs)) / len(y_true)

class MLPClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes, dropout_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 128)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(128, num_classes)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc1(x)))
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc2(x)))
        x = self.fc3(x)
        return x

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()

        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (num_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

def extract_char_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """Extract character n-grams (2-5 grams) that capture morphology and punctuation patterns."""
    if fit:
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            max_features=15000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            min_df=5,
            max_df=0.8,
        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(texts)


def extract_word_ngrams(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):

            ngram_range=(1, 3),

        )
        features = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
        return features, vectorizer
    else:
        return vectorizer.transform(texts)


def extract_pos_patterns(texts, vectorizer=None, fit=False):
    """
    Extract POS tag n-grams to capture syntactic patterns.
    Using a simple heuristic: tag words based on suffixes and patterns.
    """

    def tag_sentence(text):
        words = text.split()
        tags = []
        for w in words:
            w_clean = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if not w_clean:
                tags.append("PUNCT")
            elif w_clean in ["the", "a", "an"]:
                tags.append("DET")
            elif w_clean in ["is", "am", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being"]:
                tags.append("VERB_BE")
            elif w_clean in ["have", "has", "had", "having"]:
                tags.append("VERB_HAVE")
            elif w_clean in ["do", "does", "did", "doing", "done"]:
                tags.append("VERB_DO")
            elif w_clean in [
                "will",
                "would",
                "can",
                "could",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "may",
                "might",
                "must",
            ]:
                tags.append("MODAL")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ing"):
                tags.append("VBG")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ed"):
                tags.append("VBD")
            elif w_clean.endswith("ly"):
                tags.append("ADV")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("tion")
                or w_clean.endswith("sion")
                or w_clean.endswith("ment")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("ness")
                or w_clean.endswith("ity")
                or w_clean.endswith("ship")
            ):
                tags.append("NN")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("able")
                or w_clean.endswith("ible")
                or w_clean.endswith("ful")
            ):
                tags.append("ADJ")
            elif (
                w_clean.endswith("ous")
                or w_clean.endswith("ive")
                or w_clean.endswith("al")
            ):
                tags.append("ADJ")
            elif w_clean.endswith("s") and len(w_clean) > 2:
                tags.append("NNS")
            elif len(w_clean) <= 3 and w_clean.isalpha():
                tags.append("FUNC")
            elif w_clean[0].isupper() and len(w_clean) > 1:
                tags.append("NNP")
            else:
                tags.append("OTHER")
        return " ".join(tags)

    pos_texts = [tag_sentence(t) for t in texts]

    if fit:
        vectorizer = CountVectorizer(

        )

class MLPClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes, dropout_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 128)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(128, num_classes)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                if m.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc1(x)))
        x = self.dropout(self.relu(self.fc2(x)))
        x = self.fc3(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):

        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (num_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

    if epoch < warmup_epochs:

    else:
